interpretation: The recorded values are group sampling fractions, not exact stratified per-row inclusion probabilities. They must not be used as row propensities for inverse-probability weighting or calibration.
mechanism: Hard and ordinary negative strata are sampled separately, each with min(4,stratum size) rows. The stored inclusion field uses total selected/group size for both strata.
method: In-memory instrumentation of the frozen source label function; all seven cached label arrays exactly reproduced before comparing recorded and actual inclusion.
model_impact: None: source_corpus consumes index,y,weight,bag and never inclusion. Equal event-group training weights remain unchanged.
scope: Bounded post-hoc metadata audit; no fitting, thresholds, predictions or frozen source artifacts changed
